patch.description: 06c "Rename recording": the owner's title replaces the generated one.

delete.description: Swiped away on the phone: gone for good. A new failure raises a new update.

post.description: Undo what Root changed (an update with action "undo"): her title or kind goes.

get.description:
What changed since `since` (the last answer's `server_time`). Recordings whose
`results_version` moved should have their conversations fetched again.

post.description: Write a recording up again (S8 "Try again now", or after the keys change).

get.description:
Recordings from this recorder whose server copy matches the phone's and whose Drive copy is
verified. Empty while deleting is switched off.
What changed after `cursor` (leave it out to start from the beginning).
The day's digest as the app shows it; 404 until it's finished (or the day was quiet).

put.description: Replace her annotation. A stale If-Match gets 409 `stale_annotation` with the current one.

post.description:
Override the title or kind. Applied now, shown in Updates with undo, kept on reprocess.
Sending the same correction again confirms one that came back with `recheck`.

patch.description: Name a speaker for their whole recording. A name the owner set is never overwritten.

put.description:
Where an item went (ClickUp for project tasks, TickTick for personal ones), or that she
dismissed it. `synced` also accepts its Review item, so it stops asking the owner.

get.description: Every write, oldest first; `actor` "owner" is the owner undoing one of hers.

name_source.title: Name Source
name_source.description: Who set the name. Re-check `carried` names after a `replaces`.

recheck.title: Recheck
recheck.description: Moved here by a reprocess: confirm by sending it again, or drop it

beyond.title: Beyond
beyond.description: From the web, not the recording: shown apart, never cited

url.title: Url
url.description: Short-lived link to the original Ogg Opus file

deleting_enabled.title: Deleting Enabled
deleting_enabled.description: Off until the owner has watched the gate for a while

sha256.title: Sha256
sha256.description: The phone deletes only if its own copy still has this checksum

CostsView.title: CostsView
CostsView.description: What outside services cost (milestone 7): today, this calendar month and in total.

ElevenLabsAccount.title: ElevenLabsAccount
ElevenLabsAccount.description: Live from ElevenLabs: the plan and how many of this period's credits are used.

GoogleSignInRequest.title: GoogleSignInRequest
GoogleSignInRequest.description:
Android sends `id_token` (and `drive_auth_code` when Drive is granted). The web sends
only `drive_auth_code` from one Google popup; its ID token comes back from the exchange.

domain.title: Domain
domain.description: Host to pass to the SDK, e.g. platform-us.plaud.ai

PurposeLine.title: PurposeLine
PurposeLine.description:
What the app used a service for, this month: transcribe, tidy, understand, digest, ask,
web_search, or other (entries from before purposes were recorded).

part_bytes.title: Part Bytes
part_bytes.description: Size of every part but the last

parts.title: Parts
parts.description: How many parts the whole file takes

received_bytes.title: Received Bytes
received_bytes.description: Bytes stored so far, counted from the start

next_part.title: Next Part
next_part.description: The part to send next; null when all are in

started_at.title: Started At
started_at.description: When the recording began, in UTC

sha256.title: Sha256
sha256.description: Lower-case hex SHA-256 of the whole file

text.title: Text
text.description: The owner's wording; empty resets it

needs_review.title: Needs Review
needs_review.description: Not empty: show a "check this" badge

RootNote.title: RootNote
RootNote.description: What Root (the owner's agent) noted on a conversation: links and "check this" questions.

edited_at.title: Edited At
edited_at.description: When the owner made the edit; the latest edit wins

drive_error.title: Drive Error
drive_error.description: Why the Drive grant wasn't saved, if a code was sent
